description: One of the dock's two stored layers. `user` is what tells them apart: set means that person's own arrangement, applied last and winning; blank means the site layer, curated by a Workspace Manager and applying to everyone. Both span every app and name none. The layer below them is not a document at all -- an app declares its fragment through the `add_to_dock` hook, because a dock row accumulates no state a hook cannot express. Same shape at both stored layers, because the rows are identical and the parent is what says whose they are; see `Custom Sidebar`, which layers the same way.

fields.description: The person whose own arrangement this is. Blank means the site layer, which applies to everyone and is overridden by each user's own.
fields.label: User

fields.description: The ordered entries this layer has an opinion about. Row order is the arrangement; an entry this layer never names keeps its incoming order and follows the ones it does, which is how a newly installed app's modules still reach someone who has already arranged their dock.
fields.label: Dock Items

name: Dock
